name: terminal-nook
description: Terminal Nook (the Staddle Granary, 49 / 50.13): one plan drawn twice, the vanilla build and (TOMS=1) its Tom's Simple Storage copy. MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes both candidates.

scripts.build: node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && TOMS=1 node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py terminal_nook terminal_nook --candidate --nbt out/terminal-nook.nbt && mkdir -p ../../../../build/rebuild/terminal_nook/modded && python3 ../../rebuild.py terminal_nook modded/terminal_nook --candidate --nbt out/terminal-nook-toms.nbt
